otland_threads.author: Marcin89
otland_threads.first_post_excerpt: M Marcin89 New Member Joined Nov 15, 2008 Messages 1 Reaction score 2 Jul 7, 2026 #1 Project Antica uses as a base the original CipSoft map made using thousands of 7.4 .cam files combined with CipSoft leaked files. All creatures, NPC's, daily respawns and quests have their exact location at the time. Furthermore, all combat formulas, attacks, creature resistance and loot, NPC's dialogues, everything is in accordance with the version we know. But not only that, we dedicated dozens of hours to re-create its main mechanics: Accurate 7.4 Formulas All combat formulas faithfully recreated to match the original 7.4 experience. Classic Combat Exhaustion The original exhaustion system is in place — no rapid-fire spell spam. No Hotkeys for Objects Items must be used manually from your backpack, just like the old days. No UseEx on Battlelist You cannot use items with crosshair (useEx) directly on players in the battlelist. No Runes from NPC's Runes are not sold by NPC's — you must craft them yourself with blank runes and mana. No Level Requirements for Spells & Items Spells can be learned and items can be used at any level, as it was in 7.4. No Protection Zones on Boats Boats are not safe — watch your back when traveling.
